svg.title: Landing zone governance design
svg.desc: Redraw of the Learn picture for the governance design area. A landing zone subscription holds IAM and Policy next to Management and Monitoring. Roles, for example NetOps, SecOps and DevOps, sit beside IAM. Subscription policy, for example allowed resource providers, encryption at rest and no public IP, sits beside Policy. Metrics, logs and alerts and Security Center sit beside Management and Monitoring. Inside, several applications, with Cost Management and Azure Monitor on the left. An application template holds app resources (VM, DB, storage, hybrid), IAM, Policy, Keys and Monitor, with Network Watcher and Microsoft Defender for Cloud on the right. Shared Services and Networking sit in a band at the bottom. Icons are official Azure icons.
